scope: 26.2 Forge 65.1.2, canonical publisher Oculus 0.3.0-beta.1 and canonical BSL 10.1.1

pipeline_design.preparation: Requires and preprocesses both world0/gbuffers_terrain vertex+fragment and world0/gbuffers_entities vertex+fragment; every pack and adapted source receives a full SHA-256.
pipeline_design.compilation: Clears the device cache transactionally, precompiles BSL-bound replacements under Minecraft's real terrain/entity RenderPipeline identities, then compiles the fullscreen chain without invalidating either family.
pipeline_design.render_use: The exact GlRenderPass backend records a bind only after the real pipeline is acquired and records a nonempty draw only after the OpenGL encoder call returns, carrying the same program SHA as compilation.
pipeline_design.deactivation: Clears activation properties and the GPU pipeline cache before vanilla lazy recompilation.
pipeline_design.failure_policy: Missing source pairs, changed native shader anchors, invalid OpenGL compilation, input class hash mismatch, missing render-pass transform sentinel, and proof-log write failure all fail closed.
